| [Go-live guardrails](SKILL.md) | Agent Skill | Run the self-check a plant completes before it declares a catalogued use case live without OD labour (new-state Lane 1, "Validate and go live"): data present, platform boundary respected, system footprint kept, no invented figures, a named plant owner, the three-question handover test passed, Cyber Security cleared where a connection is external. Use when a plant has applied a catalogued template and wants to go live, when someone asks whether a self-served use case is safe to adopt, or when a guardrail is proposed.
